Hero.description: React & TypeScript developer with commercial experience building media workflows, cross-platform interfaces, and internal administration tools.

About.description:
Hi, I'm Xiaonan. 👋

I’m a frontend developer who enjoys building interactive web experiences. 

My main tools are React and TypeScript. I like turning UI designs into working applications, managing complex states, and paying attention to the small details that make interfaces feel smooth and intuitive. 

I also enjoy understanding the bigger picture, so I’ve been exploring how frontend applications connect with backend systems using tools like Prisma and PostgreSQL. 

In my previous frontend role, I collaborated with designers, backend engineers and a mobile team. I’m always looking build meaningful products.

items.title: Short-Video Platform
items.description: A mobile-first vertical video experience with continuous browsing, playback preferences and saved-video flows.
highlights: Continuous vertical feed with proactive video preloading
Shared playback, volume and bookmark state across routes

caseStudy.challenge: Make a media-heavy feed feel immediate while keeping playback behaviour predictable as users move between videos and saved content.
caseStudy.approach: Separated server data from UI state, preloaded upcoming media, and centralized playback preferences and bookmarks in a persisted Zustand store.
caseStudy.outcome: A responsive viewing flow with seamless navigation between discovery and saved videos.

items.title: Job Board Platform
items.description: An authenticated job portal connecting job-seeker and employer workflows to relational data.
highlights: Type-safe relational data with Prisma and PostgreSQL

caseStudy.challenge: Design one product around distinct user roles while keeping protected actions and data relationships understandable.
caseStudy.approach: Built authenticated flows with Auth.js, modeled jobs and users in Prisma, and connected reusable forms and listings to server-side data.
caseStudy.outcome: An end-to-end product demonstrating frontend delivery, authentication and database design.

items.title: Music App
items.description: A web music player with synchronized playback, queue and playlist controls across the interface.
highlights: One synchronized audio engine across the application
Queue, playlist and playback state designed as reusable actions

caseStudy.challenge: Keep playback, the active track, controls and playlists synchronized across multiple parts of the interface.
caseStudy.approach: Designed a centralized Zustand audio store and reusable player controls, then connected remote music data through a consistent API layer.
caseStudy.outcome: A cohesive player where navigation and playlist edits do not interrupt or desynchronize playback.
